notes: A muted sage title landscape surrounds charcoal panels with ivory text and amber actions. Organized menus put Play, your career, practice, controls and settings in clear sections. Compact in-game windows keep the world visible around NPC conversations, shops, inventory, the journal and map. Search and filter market goods, inspect cargo, and follow your next useful action. E uses the same nearby target as the prompt for rockets, vehicles and workplaces. The Earth rocket fits its actual landing feet to the final town terrain, with matching server boarding checks. Apply the signed update and restart, or install the full package. All clients and the public server use 0.7.0 / protocol 13. Bootstrap 3 is retained; versions older than 0.4.10 need the full installer. Existing saves are preserved.
